Method of Attack: Retrieves an additional malicious script from an external source
Runs a Discord bot, enabling the theft of sensitive data, executing arbitrary commands, encrypting files, and disabling Microsoft Defender Antivirus
Renders the computer inoperable by escalating CPU usage, inserting a Windows Batch script in the startup directory to force a shutdown, and inducing a blue screen of death (BSOD) error
Impacted Systems: Computers susceptible to CPU usage escalation and forced shutdowns
Attack Vector: Typosquatting to mimic legitimate obfuscation tools
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of setup.py and init.py files that retrieve a Python script from transfer[.]sh
Suspicious activity related to Discord bot operations
